text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off. Haru Urara was standing on a 
special stage in the usual shopping 
district—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ahem, *cough*! Hello, everyoneー!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Folk
text_block_list.text: Hellooo!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm Haru Urara, and I've become this 
shopping district's "poster Umamusume"!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"If I'm supposed to be a poster girl, 
should I just stand here looking sharp?"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
There's no way that's true, Urara-chan! 
Wahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? I don't really get it, but I'll do my 
absolute best! Nice to meet you!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Folk
text_block_list.text: Nice to meet you! I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The story goes back a few days ago—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"‘Poster Umamusume,’ ‘Store Manager for a 
Day,’ ‘PR Ambassador’... Are ALL of those 
my jobs?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara, who had been giving it her all 
in races. Out of the blue, a PR job offer 
came in for her!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, so cool, so cool! Sooo cool! That 
looks like so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "I wanna try it! Where can I do that?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Though the company and store names 
differed, all the job requests came from 
the very same address. Yes—that shopping 
district that loves Haru Urara so much."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Is that right! So it's kind of like 
helping out like you usually do?
choice_data_list: Since this is work, it's a bit different.
Since this is work, it's a bit different.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Handling the PR means Haru Urara will 
become the face of that shopping district 
in both name and reality. There's a clear 
benefit in boosting her recognition."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For Haru Urara right now, boosting her 
popularity as an Umamusume is just as 
crucial as her training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, explaining it won't help you 
understand. So...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! Haru Urara, let's go, let's go, 
yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, Haru Urara had come not to play, 
but for work.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, Urara-chan, I'm counting on 
you today!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! ...I mean, yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're fine just being your usual 
self, Urara-chan!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? King-chan always said, "Mind 
your manners when you're on the job!" 
though.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Still, if mister says it's okay, then it's 
totally okay! *beaming smile*♪

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, that's our Urara-chan! Well then, 
jumping right into it, can I ask you to do 
a job? I want you to go around to the 
shops in the shopping district!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah, got it! I'll spin round and round!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Spinning round and round!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah! Fish shop mister! Hello!

text_block_list.name: Fishmonger Guy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Urara-chan! Full of pep as always, I 
see!

text_block_list.name: Fishmonger Guy
text_block_list.text:
How about it, wanna buy something? We've 
got some great bonito in stock!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, are you sure you wanna say that? 
I'm pretty picky when it comes to bonito!

text_block_list.name: Fishmonger Guy
text_block_list.text:
"That's all the more reason! Come on, 
let's settle this with a match!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Deal! If I can get you to say it's 
delicious, then this old man wins!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So yummy~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Fishmonger Guy
text_block_list.text:
Alright! That's Urara-chan's official seal 
of approval!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, looks like things are getting pretty 
lively over there.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
You're right. A fishmonger? Maybe I should 
buy something for dinner tonight.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, ladies over there! Please, come take 
a look!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It was a heartwarming sight. Wherever 
Haru Urara went, crowds gathered, bringing 
with them a blooming excitement.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, what a huge daikon radish! This 
is only 100 yen~?!

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Auntie
text_block_list.text:
Of course, exactly 100 yen! They're nice 
and plump, and totally delicious!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: It looks so delicious! Can I nibble on it?

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Auntie
text_block_list.text:
Well, absolutely! As long as you buy, as 
much as you want!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Urrrgh... I'm in! Give me five of them!

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Auntie
text_block_list.text: Thanks for your business!

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text: Way to go, Haru Urara! Ahahaha...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hello, hello~! Come buy some, everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey! Big sis, are you a horse girl?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's right! We're gonna go zoom-zoom and 
run a whole bunch!

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
Is that so! Well then, I'll cheer for you 
next time!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Really? Yay, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Haru Urara is wildly popular wherever 
she goes. If she builds up the skills to 
match, she'll be able to win any race. 
Just then..."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, you over there. Are you 
Urara-chan's Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That woman was a member of the local 
shopping district promotion association, 
having watched over Haru Urara ever since 
her enrollment.
choice_data_list: Thank you very much for the job request.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
If anything, I should be thanking you. 
Thanks to you, Urara-chan, it's been a 
huge help.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
Ever since Urara-chan came along, this 
shopping street has become so much 
livelier. Before that, it was truly 
deserted.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
...Urara-chan isn't really all that 
strong, is she?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
"I'd heard for a while that she couldn't 
win, so..."
choice_data_list:
Still, Urara is working hard and getting 
stronger!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm sure she's trying her best. But 
still... It's not like you can suddenly 
get stronger overnight, right?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine. As long as you run with a 
smile on your face, Urara-chan, that's all 
that matters to us..."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
It just gives me so much encouragement. 
That alone makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she speaks, she looks gently at Haru 
Urara. Her gaze is filled with an 
affection reminiscent of a parent looking 
at their child.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As long as she runs happily, that's 
enough." For the people watching over her 
like parents, that is likely their honest 
truth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—is that truly all right?
